title: Nice Crisp Spanish Shrimp Paella
description: A salty and crisp Spanish dish featuring shrimp and Thai sweet basil, cooked in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware pot, following ayurvedic sattvic friendly principles.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and just cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the pot and set aside.
Add the smoked paprika and salt to the pot and stir for 1 minute.
Add the Arborio rice to the pot and stir to coat the rice in the oil and spice mixture.
Add the water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the chopped Thai sweet basil and lemon juice.
Return the cooked shrimp to the pot and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the shrimp are heated through.
